title: Seagrove Drift Away Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewSteps to the Private Beach, BRAND NEW renovations, 3 Bikes - Drift AwayThe Space Drift Away – Renovated Seagrove Retreat Steps from the Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Steps to Private Beach Access – Just a short stroll to sugar-white sand King Suite + Flexible Bunk Rooms – Perfect for families or groups Fully Renovated – Fresh coastal décor & updated interiors Open-Concept Living – Bright layout with Smart TV & cozy seating Fully Equipped Kitchen – Stainless appliances & everything you need Private Patio – Ideal for morning coffee or evening cocktails Bonus Sleeping – Sleeper sofa in living room for extra guests High-Speed Wi-Fi – Stay connected with ease 3 Adult Bikes Included – Cruise along scenic 30A Washer & Dryer – In-unit for convenience Minutes from Seaside, Grayton & WaterColor – Prime location Community Pool Two assigned parking spaces directly in front of the unit Partial Gulf View Located on the beach side of 30A - no crossing the street! Outdoor storage for beach items Welcome to Drift AwayWelcome to Drift Away, a beautifully renovated townhome in the heart of Seagrove Beach—just steps from private beach access! Sleeping up to 8 guests, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath retreat is perfect for family vacations, couples’ getaways, or a beach trip with friends.Inside, you’ll find bright, airy spaces with all-new coastal furnishings and an open-concept layout designed for relaxing and reconnecting. The fully stocked kitchen features stainless steel appliances and everything you need to whip up easy meals after a day in the sun. The living room offers plush seating, a Smart TV, and a sleeper sofa for additional sleeping space.The primary bedroom features a comfortable king bed and a peaceful retreat to unwind. The second bedroom offers a full bed with a full trundle—great for kids or extra guests—while the third bedroom includes a twin bed with a twin trundle, making it perfect for flexible sleeping arrangements.Step outside to your private patio to enjoy your morning coffee or wind down after a beach day. Grab the included bikes and explore the charm of 30A or take the short walk to the sand for a relaxing day by the water.Centrally located in Seagrove Beach, you’re just minutes from the best of 30A—including Seaside, Grayton Beach, and WaterColor. Whether you’re biking scenic trails, browsing local boutiques, or enjoying fresh seafood, you’re in the perfect spot to experience it all.Book your stay today and drift into beach mode! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):Primary Bedroom – King bed, private en suite bathroomGuest Bedroom – Full bed with full trundle, shared bathroomGuest Bedroom – Twin bed with twin trundle, shared bathroomLiving Room – Sleeper sofa AREA ATTRACTIONS:Located in laid-back Seagrove Beach, Drift Away offers easy access to 30A’s best. Spend your days biking to Seaside for shopping and dining, exploring rare coastal dune lakes, or relaxing on the quiet beach just steps away. With local favorites like Café Thirty-A, The Surfing Deer, and Seagrove Village Market nearby, you’ll get the perfect mix of classic beach charm and elevated coastal living.Market nearby, you’ll enjoy a perfect blend of Old Florida charm and modern luxury.Show less
